outcome: Provide an explicit Desk article-image preparation command and prevent Desk marketing/subscriber dispatch until required reviewed article images are ready and their served bytes verify.

sourceEvidence.finding: The scheduled art step calls generate-news-art.mjs before promoting the draft; that generator explicitly produces procedural fallback art when no reviewed source raster exists.
Header and kind constants distinguish procedural-fallback from real source-raster; placeholders are permitted for website cadence, with generatedArt:false and reviewed:false.

Existing generator targets missing/fallback banners and pending satire, supports --dry-run/--story/--kind/--since/--limit. Preflight requires ChatGPT login, strips API billing environment keys and refuses custom billed providers.

Existing workflow generates, reviews, bounded re-rolls, ingests reviewed images, rebuilds, publishes to main, dispatches staging-first content release and verifies exact served derivative bytes. --dry-run still generates/reviews; it is not a network-free plan. Explicit --story/--kind currently constrain generation but pendingImages scans both kinds/all staged stories before review and ingest.

selectStories selects the actual up-to-six issue stories. Email image URL is assets/og/news/<date>--<slug>.png. probeDay only HEAD-checks page and image availability; missing images are omitted and unknown liveness retained before sending. It does not inspect real-art review metadata or hashes.

Daily 23:30 UTC subscriber send independently calls the digest's --send path; workflow also permits manual send. Both share the script, so readiness must be enforced in that script rather than just a schedule step.
Dispatch is armed (autoSend:true, approved test issue present); this plan preserves that existing decision and campaign idempotency.

validateStoryVisual validates banner source and review fields. validateSatireCartoon explicitly documents cartoons as optional; when present they require source-bound reviewed raster, voice, caption and disclosure fields. semanticVerified remains false absent separate approved vision evidence.

assertArticleArtSources binds banner source SHA and derivative files. assertSatireCartoon returns when no cartoon is declared, and validates source/derivatives when declared. rasterizeCards uses articleArtPath plus headline overlay for the actual email/social PNG.
No Desk/news/image URL references. The monthly member newsletter is a separate member-summary message; do not alter it or add Desk content.
Registry lists the existing image router. Project-native generation/review/deployment already fits; no new dependency, provider or paid generator is justified.

requiredKinds.banner: Required for every actual selected email story, because the email displays its generated social card and links the banner-bearing article.
requiredKinds.satire: Required only when the selected article declares visual.satireCartoon, in accordance with the existing optional-cartoon article contract. Do not introduce a new date cutoff or require an undeclared cartoon to send.
requiredKinds.generation: Expose the existing optional --kind all|banner|satire choice. Default preparation satisfies required kinds; all is an explicit option for generating optional missing cartoons as well. Never regenerate an already accepted banner just because its optional cartoon is missing.

premises.claim: The actual digest uses liveness-only image probes.
The actual digest omits missing image URLs instead of holding the send.
premises.pattern: const noArt = new Set(probe.filter((p) => p.art === 'missing').map((p) => p.slug));

premises.claim: The actual art review loop does not constrain pending items to explicit generation scope.

recipe: Add a builtins-only shared desk-email-art module. Accept explicit root/day/selected-story inputs, derive canonical article-bound source/derivative paths, require real reviewed banner metadata with matching source hash, reject procedural fallback, missing/unreviewed/unknown/drifted inputs, and validate declared satire using the existing optional-cartoon contract. Do not equate semanticVerified:false with rejection or claim semantic verification.

Represent local readiness separately from live-byte readiness. Hash current required email/social and linked-article image files; explicit live verification performs bounded GET requests to fixed first-party production URLs, requires successful image MIME and exact expected bytes, and holds on 404, wrong bytes, wrong MIME, timeout or other unknown result. A live HEAD or stale preparation receipt cannot satisfy it.

Add prepare-desk-email.mjs. Its default and --dry-run are network-free status/plan plus existing digest HTML/text preview; they must never load mail credentials, generate, publish or send. Explicit --generate composes existing scoped ChatGPT-plan generation/review/ingest/release, only for missing required story/kind targets. Explicit --verify-live performs readiness reads and reports pass/hold. No send option or mail-provider import exists in this preparation command.

Scope desk-art-autopilot pending-image review and approved ingest to the exact parsed --story and --kind set, as well as generation/re-rolls. Validate unknown IDs/kinds. Preserve default scheduled behavior without explicit scope. Staged unrelated images must not enter a preparation run's review, re-roll, ingest, publication proof or generated receipt.

Use the readiness module inside build-desk-dispatch-digest main before both test-recipient and subscriber-send side effects. Preserve early no-edition skip and existing armed/stale-issue checks. Once effective issue selection is known, hold the entire issue if any required image lacks reviewed local source or verified served bytes; do not silently omit the image or drop an art-unready selected story to pass. No Brevo listing, campaign creation/update/sendNow or test-send call may occur after a nonpassing art gate.

Keep --dry-run useful even when art is unready: render a preview and list exact missing story/kind reasons and next preparation command, explicitly not send-ready. Add a distinct held-art outcome to workflow summaries so a green held run never claims mail was sent. Preserve arming approval, one-address test authorization, unsubscribe/disclosure content, daily campaign naming/idempotency and no retries on ambiguous sendNow.

Expose package aliases and a short public-safe CLI guide explaining plan -> explicit generate/review/publish -> live verification -> existing separately authorized send. Existing art autopilot operates in its own origin/main worktree; preparation must distinguish that committed/published artifact from a possibly dirty caller checkout rather than silently pulling or rewriting the caller tree. The actual digest recomputes readiness from its current selected day and does not blindly trust a cached ready receipt.
acceptance: A single network-free command for a date renders the existing email preview and reports ready/pending images with explicit reason codes and exact next commands; no model, provider, Git mutation, deployment, mail credential or send call occurs.

Explicit generation plans include only missing required images for actual selected stories; accepted imagery and unrelated staged backlog are preserved. Existing generation authentication, review, ingest, staging-first deployment and exact served-byte gates remain intact.

Both manual and scheduled actual digest send paths, including single-recipient test mode, make zero mail-provider calls when an image is missing, procedural, unreviewed, hash-drifted or not exactly verified live. Existing no-edition and arming behavior remains distinct.

A fully reviewed, hash-matching, live-matching fixture reaches the existing campaign/test-send branch exactly once, with original idempotency and ambiguous-send handling unchanged. A changed day selection or changed image invalidates prior readiness.

Declared satire is validated and required; an undeclared optional cartoon does not become a new email mandate. Current member-summary newsletter and website procedural-fallback cadence remain unchanged.

No real image-generation session, email, provider spend or deployment is needed for acceptance of the workflow code during this arc. Any actual image generation remains explicitly invoked outside the arc single-session constraint.
offlineTests: Pure readiness positive/negative fixtures: reviewed real banner passes local checks; procedural fallback, missing source, missing derivative, wrong source hash, missing review/reviewer, malformed IDs and unsafe source paths fail closed.
Optional-cartoon contract: no declared cartoon does not block; declared cartoon missing source/derivative or mismatching review hash blocks; valid declared cartoon passes.

Dependency-injected first-party fetch: matching image bytes pass; 404/410/500/challenge/timeout/wrong MIME/wrong bytes/malformed response remain nonpassing, with bounded requests and no unrestricted outbound URL construction.

Invoke the actual digest main with temporary day/art fixtures and injected provider fetch. For every held-art case assert zero Brevo GET/POST/PUT calls. Test both --send and --test-to; preserve no-edition skip and unarmed hold without network. Valid-art fixture reaches original idempotent campaign path exactly once.

Preparation CLI default, --dry-run, --help and invalid arguments run under network/spawn/mail-credential mutation witnesses and prove no generation, Git write, deployment or mail send. Inject generation runner to inspect exact --story/--kind commands without spawning Codex.

Autopilot scope fixture: mixed staged banners/cartoons and multiple days; explicit one-story banner run cannot review, re-roll, approve or ingest another story/kind, while unscoped scheduled behavior stays the same.
Regression witnesses: replace real-art check with existence-only or allow unknown live bytes and observe held-art tests fail; remove explicit review scope and observe unrelated-backlog fixture fail.

founderCommands.send: Use the existing separately authorized digest send/test command only after readiness; preparation itself never sends.

limitations: This is source discovery and an implementation recipe, not implemented or deployed behavior.
No provider calls, generation, email sends, downloads or source edits were performed during discovery.
The existing scheduled art fallback remains useful for website publishing; the new email-specific gate is stricter by founder request.
Do not label autoplay art generation as a no-side-effect dry-run; its existing --dry-run performs model generation and review.
No new API fallback, spending, custom provider, membership policy, identity flow or monthly newsletter content is selected.
